verdict.rationale: Navan's documented Expense API retrieves and updates card transactions and manual expenses, with batch update via PATCH and custom-field management, so an agent could pull transactions and write coding back. The hosted MCP server is documented for querying spend and explaining why transactions were flagged, not for writing changes. missing for 10: explicit filtering for uncoded transactions, documented MCP write-back of categorizations or policy flags, a review/staging step for agent-pushed coding before it is finalized, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull uncoded transactions via API or MCP, propose categorizations and policy flags, and push clean coding back for review
